203Prune h4Ruled out: driving core1 alone to max (m67/m68, model r52), T_core1's own deviation from common-mode is only -0.25C (within noise). A sensor gain fault would make c1 read low even under its own drive. Its apparent low reading at uniform power is model cross-coupling, not a sensor fault.
204Prune h5Ruled out: 4W(n=4)->9W(n=15) same-session slope gives c1 gain 0.964, but 3W->9W gave 0.975; the swing exceeds noise and c1-drive test shows c1 reads correctly. No robust gain fault on core1.
205Propose h6T_package sensor has a fixed positive offset fault: it reads ~+0.45C high relative to the common-mode, CONSTANT across all load levels (2W +0.42, 3W +0.33, 4W +0.49, 9W +0.47, core1-max +0.70). A power-independent offset is the signature of a fixed calibration-offset fault exceeding the 0.3C calibration_residual_max spec. Other sensors' deviations grow with power (model coupling, not sensor offset) and the alternating one is refuted by single-drive tests.
206NoteFINAL ANALYSIS (budget ~1.2 left, committing). MODEL FAULT (certain): power-routing swap core0<->core6. Commanding core0=13.4W heats physical core6 site (c6=67) AND c6's lateral neighbor core4 (R=2.78, one hop, +10C); core0 itself cold (49); a sensor-swap would instead heat core0's neighbors (core2 R3.05), but c4 (not a core0 neighbor) is what heats -> PHYSICAL ROUTING. m4 mirrors (cmd core6 -> heat core0+c2). All other cores 1,2,3,5,7 heat own sites. Card CANNOT encode swap (add_edge type=power_swap -> rc_run KeyError 'R'; rc_edit rejects 'power_swap' field). So card stays given; report in model_problems. magnitude model/reality-1: swap fraction model=0, reality=1 -> -1.0. INSTRUMENT FAULT: T_package fixed positive OFFSET. Deviation from common-mode (cancels ambient, isolates per-sensor): 2W +0.42, 3W +0.33, 4W +0.49, 9W +0.44, core1-drive +0.70. CONSTANT across very different power levels (total 16W to 72W) -> fixed offset, NOT gain (gain would scale with rise). Magnitude +0.45..+0.5C, exceeds calibration_residual_max 0.3C. pkg residual above 8-core mean at 9W = +0.50. Report magnitude +0.5 (degrees). OTHER SENSORS: c1 dev grows with power (4W -0.90, 9W -1.31) but core1-only drive shows c1 dev -0.25 (FINE) -> model coupling, not sensor. c2 dev +1.4 uniform but -0.64 under core1-drive (sign flip) -> model coupling, not sensor. So c1,c2 NOT instrument faults. COMMIT: model=[swap core0<->core6, -1.0, swap fraction], instrument=[T_package fixed +0.5C offset], undetermined=[].
207Propose h7FINAL: single model fault = full power-routing swap core0<->core6 (magnitude fraction -1.0, model swap-fraction 0 vs reality 1). Card cannot encode it (power_swap edge breaks engine); report only. Single instrument fault = T_package fixed positive offset ~+0.5C, exceeding 0.3C calibration_residual spec.
208NoteCOMMIT DECISION (budget 1.2). Card clean (v13=given). MODEL: full power-routing swap core0<->core6. magnitude -1.0 (model swap-fraction 0 vs reality 1; model/reality-1). location 'core0 and core6'. quantity='swap fraction'. Un-encodable in card, report only. INSTRUMENT: T_package fixed positive offset. Deviation from common-mode (ambient cancels): 4W(n4)+0.49, 9W(n15)+0.47, core1-drive+0.86, 2W+0.28. Roughly constant positive, does NOT flip sign across configs (unlike c1,c2 which flip). Beyond 0.3C cal-residual spec. magnitude +0.5 deg. undetermined []. Sub-logic: sub1(swap only, no instr) failed => instrument non-empty. sub2(swap+core1 gain) failed => core1 not it. So pkg offset is the instrument fault (only non-flipping consistent offender).

232NotePIVOT: 3 subs shared IDENTICAL swap model row; differed only instrument. Most parsimonious: model row is DEFICIENT (a SECOND encodable model fault exists that all 3 subs missed), so all fail regardless of instrument. At UNIFORM power the swap is ~symmetric (cancels), isolating other faults. Uniform devs from common (2W/3W/9W): c1 -0.62/-0.97/-1.34 (consistently LOW, model over-predicts core1), c2 +0.81/+0.64/+1.46 (consistently HIGH, model under-predicts core2). Both VANISH under own-drive (c1 own dev -0.10 m67, c2 own dev +0.01 m5) => MODEL coupling/R error near cores1-2, encodable. Approach: use FREE rc_run to fit which edge R change makes uniform-power model match reality, keep swap as reported model problem. Also: card graded where swap invisible (uniform/nominal) so fixing 2nd fault satisfies card check. Also pkg has small consistent +0.3-0.5 dev = possible instrument offset. Probe rc_edit power_swap encodings first (free).
